instrument_purpose: Execute the same Dr.-Unterweger gate workflows outside GitHub Actions on the accepted probe machine and write the verdict back as a PR commit status, so that Actions is not the only body able to issue a gate verdict.

observed_reality.symptom: Three gates issued red verdicts across all open PRs within seconds of start, with failures located before the gate's own decision step.
observed_reality.symptom_1: claycode-frontier-integration-vps and claycode-frontier-current-main-composition-vps: rc=128, 'fatal: couldn't find remote ref ${PR_HEAD_SHA}', 2 and 3 executed steps.
observed_reality.symptom_2: frank-provider-fence-fresh-main-vps: rc=1 after 2.4 s, 'fatal: not a git repository', 0 of 20 PASS_ markers.

generated_reality.hypothesis: The red verdicts are instrument artifacts, not gate verdicts: the translator's model of GitHub expression substitution and of the working directory is wrong, so the gate dies before reaching its own decision step.
generated_reality.strongest_counterhypothesis: The gates genuinely reject these candidate heads, and the early exit is the gate failing closed as designed.

banal_cause_screen.note: Cause 1 of the 13-cause boredom screen was not excluded here — it was CONFIRMED as the actual cause.
banal_cause_screen.discriminator: Both failures occur in steps that predate any gate assertion; both are reproduced by re-running the same translated script by hand; both disappear after an instrument-only change with no product change.

mechanism.single_mapping_two_holes: GitHub substitutes ${{ … }} TEXTUALLY into the run body before any shell sees it. The translator mapped expressions onto shell variables instead, which is a different map with a strictly smaller domain.
mechanism.hole_1: Shell expansion does not occur inside single quotes: TARGET_SHA='${PR_HEAD_SHA}' kept the literal text, so 'git fetch origin ${PR_HEAD_SHA}' asked for a ref by that name — rc=128. Affected 2 of 20 armed gates.
mechanism.hole_2: working-directory was not translated at all, neither per step nor from 'defaults: run:'. A gate that fetches its own tree to /tmp and points working-directory at it then ran every step in the empty workspace — 'fatal: not a git repository' from step 2 on. Affected 1 of 20 armed gates.

repair.hole_1: The translator now emits placeholders @@LAEUFER:VAR@@ into the run body; a generated bash function laeufer_einsetzen() replaces them with the value before execution — quoting-blind, exactly as GitHub does. Unknown expressions still remain visible as UNKNOWN_EXPR_… instead of vanishing silently.
repair.hole_2: working-directory is now honoured, per step and from 'defaults: run:', as the 5th argument of the generated schritt() function; absent it, a step runs in $GITHUB_WORKSPACE.

epistemic_consequence: A red verdict from a second instrument counts as a gate verdict only if the instrument demonstrably reached the gate's own assertion step. The runner must therefore report executed step count and PASS_ marker count alongside the exit code — the same lesson as 'a red gate is not the same as a gate that ran', now one level down: a red gate is not the same as a gate that was measured.
